# Third-party optical engine

`apple-liquid-glass-webgl/` contains the unmodified npm distribution of **apple-liquid-glass-webgl 2.6.0**, by Oliver Nemo, licensed under MIT. Its license is retained at `apple-liquid-glass-webgl/LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/Oliverrr2424/webgl-apple-liquid-glass
Published commit: `e8030bd0732bc91652e44b85f84e2ed7aa498679`
Tarball SHA-1 (npm): `31242d6045ce90ae501c9629591d722c1b3b19ac`

The website uses the public `LiquidGlass` API from `src/index.js` with live DOM backdrop capture. Package demo assets are not used by the site. No runtime CDN or npm installation is required. The site layout, copy, CSS, and integration are original. No code or assets from naughtyduk/liquidGL have been copied.
